---
title: "Public Information about Certification"
---

## Public Listing of Certified Members {#sec-public-information}

The ASA maintains a public list (e.g., a web page) of certified data scientists. Inclusion in the list does not represent an endorsement by the ASA. The list may include:

- The member's name and contact information
- Optionally, a link to a personal website where the member may provide additional information about their experience and expertise

::: {.callout-important}
If a member's certification lapses or is revoked, the member's information shall be removed from the public listing **within 90 days**.
:::
